description:
AWS DynamoDB adapter for the Culvert framework. Sprint-21 module
        (epic #144, T21.4 / issue #148). Implements JobControlRepository over
        DynamoDB as an append-only ledger (Sprint 23, AD-2/AD-3/AD-13): one
        item per state change under a (run_id, event_seq) composite key, reads
        projected with the earliest terminal state winning, and no UpdateItem
        anywhere. createJob stays an atomic conditional insert.
